## Overview

CloudAMQP is a managed RabbitMQ and LavinMQ hosting provider operated by 84codes AB (Sweden). It offers shared and dedicated RabbitMQ instances across AWS, Azure, and GCP, with plans ranging from free development tiers to high-throughput dedicated clusters. CloudAMQP is the largest managed RabbitMQ provider by customer count.

## Products & Services

- **Managed RabbitMQ** — Shared and dedicated RabbitMQ instances. Dedicated plans range from single-node (500 msg/s) to 5-node clusters (200k msg/s). Supports AMQP 0.9.1, MQTT, STOMP, WebSocket.
- **Managed LavinMQ** — Lightweight AMQP-compatible broker (CloudAMQP's own product). Higher throughput per dollar than RabbitMQ.
- **Add-ons** — VPC peering (USD $99/mo), extra disk space (USD $0.35/GB/mo).

## Pricing Model

RabbitMQ dedicated plans (selected tiers relevant to this use case):

| Plan | Nodes | Throughput | Connections | USD/month |
|------|-------|-----------|-------------|-----------|
| Big Bunny | 3 | 1k msg/s | 9k | $297 |
| Happy Hare | 3 | 8k msg/s | 12k | $597 |
| Roaring Rabbit | 3 | 10k msg/s | 15k | $897 |

Shared plans: Little Lemur (free, 1M msg/mo), Tough Tiger ($19/mo, 10M msg/mo).

**Confidence**: HIGH (pricing extracted directly from cloudamqp.com/plans.html)

## Australian Presence

- Australian data centres: PROBABLE — CloudAMQP deploys on AWS, Azure, and GCP, all of which have Australian regions. Specific confirmation of ap-southeast-2 (Sydney) availability for dedicated RabbitMQ plans required.

## Government Award History

> Not applicable. Australian university context.

## Strengths

- Lowest managed-service cost for a production-grade message broker
- Operationally simple — CloudAMQP manages patching, monitoring, backups
- Multi-node clusters with multi-AZ deployment for high availability
- AMQP 0.9.1 open protocol — low lock-in
- Supports quorum queues, streams (RabbitMQ 4.1+), and delayed message exchange
- Good community support; G2 reviews positive

## Weaknesses

- **No native schema registry** — the defining requirement from ADR-001 is not met; requires Apicurio sidecar
- Schema validation would be application-level, not broker-enforced
- VPC peering is an add-on cost (USD $99/mo)
- Limited enterprise features compared to Azure Service Bus or Confluent Cloud
- Support is email-based for most plans; dedicated support only on higher tiers
- RabbitMQ 4.1 (Feb 2026) adds streams but still no schema registry
